headline: King Arthur's Sourdough Sidekick automates starter feeding for $179.99
summary: The Sourdough Sidekick automates sourdough starter feeding, works with most flour types, and has a custom mode.
details: The Sourdough Sidekick, backed by King Arthur flour, automates the boring bit of sourdough baking: starter management. It feeds your starter flour and water on a set schedule, ready for exactly when you want to bake.
The device works with most flour types, but requires recalibration for different densities. It has a custom mode and is designed to work with 15g of starter to begin with.
The Sourdough Sidekick launched with a crowdfunding campaign in March 2025 and is now available to buy directly from King Arthur for $179.99, though it's US-only.
caption:
Can a $179.99 gadget really simplify sourdough baking?

The Sourdough Sidekick, backed by King Arthur flour, automates the boring bit of sourdough baking: starter management. It feeds your starter flour and water on a set schedule, ready for exactly when you want to bake.

The device works with most flour types, but requires recalibration for different densities. It has a custom mode and is designed to work with 15g of starter to begin with.

The Sourdough Sidekick launched with a crowdfunding campaign in March 2025 and is now available to buy directly from King Arthur for $179.99, though it's US-only.

headline_marked: Developer builds [[dental insurance claim verifier]] with Cognee's GraphRAG
headline: Developer builds dental insurance claim verifier with Cognee's GraphRAG
summary: A developer created Cover-Clarity, a tool that helps Aetna policyholders understand dental coverage using Cognee's GraphRAG. It provides precise, policy-traced answers.
details: Insurance claim denials cost policyholders billions of dollars every year due to complex policy documents. A developer created Cover-Clarity, a tool that uses Cognee's GraphRAG to help Aetna policyholders understand dental coverage.

Cover-Clarity lets users input a patient's medical history and ask natural-language questions about dental coverage, providing precise, policy-traced answers. It currently serves Aetna's Bronze Benefit Plan.

Cognee's GraphRAG builds a hybrid graph-vector knowledge store from documents, allowing it to reason across complex policy structures. The tool also features session memory, persisting conversations for 7 days.

The developer, Rushank Savant, built Cover-Clarity for the WeMakeDevs × Cognee Hackathon. The live app is available at cover-clarity.onrender.com and the GitHub repository is at github.com/Rushanksavant/Cover-Clarity.
caption:
